recommendation: Keep this narrow source fix. Do not add valueSet/unit or remove the inline parameter without a later final work-group decision; revisit operation design only if FHIR-56320 or a corresponding FHIR-core issue is applied.
issue_request: FHIR-50488 was Applied with a Persuasive resolution for R6. It asked the Measure $evaluate operation to accept supplementalData input parameters so callers can request additional supplemental data in the MeasureReport without creating a new Measure.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#3811 applied the issue in source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate.xml. Commit 7590be91ee added supplementalData with code, usage, description, and criteria parts, and commit 701d4e6c70 added measureUrl scoping for multi-measure evaluation. The structure was present in current source, but the follow-up measureUrl documentation still used stale stratifier wording.
additional_context: Measure is active in source/fhir.ini and source/measure/list-Measure-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Measure-evaluate, so the edited XML is build-scope source. FHIR-50489 is a separate same-family stratifier issue already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-56320 is a later Triaged DEQM proposal to replace inline stratifier/supplementalData parameters, but it is not a final FHIR-core decision.
reconciliation: Changed only source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate.xml, correcting the supplementalData typo from "same was" to "same way" and changing supplementalData.measureUrl documentation from stratifier terminology to supplemental-data terminology.
source_changes: source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate.xml: corrected supplementalData documentation and supplementalData.measureUrl copy/paste wording.
